Create an omelet with 1 whole egg plus 2 egg whites,
sweet peppers, and onions.  Serve with oven-browned
potatoes and a slice of whole-grain toast topped lightly
with butter or margarine.  Or, better yet, top with jam or
jelly as a no-fat alternative.  Remember to include fruit
or juice.  This 500-calorie meal—although it contains
cholesterol—is a good source of iron and is high in fiber,
folate, and vitamin C.
